list_items.text: 一、 交货期限：供应商应于2026年10月30日前将全部货物送达指定地点。
（一） 所有电子元件须符合RoHS标准，并随货提供出厂检验报告；
（二） 结构件表面不得有划痕、毛刺或变形。
三、 付款方式：货到验收合格后30日内，以银行转账方式支付全部货款。
四、 以上价格均含13%增值税，运费由供应商承担。
送货时请携带本订单复印件及送货单一式两份。

notes: The two-line name cell "不锈钢螺丝 M3×8" + "（每包100颗）" is joined with ONE space (table-cell rule); the no-space rule applies only to a sentence that wraps. Simplified Chinese purchase order of a fictional company, one page. Chinese is written without spaces between words: a sentence wrapped across lines joins with NO space. Body paragraphs have a two-character first-line indent. The header key/value grid has four columns (two label/value pairs per row) and no header row; the last value spans three columns and is repeated. Item table, full grid: the first column "类别" (category) spans three and two rows and is repeated; "合计" spans seven columns, "金额大写" two and its amount in Chinese capital numerals six -- all repeated. One name cell holds two lines joined with one space. Terms list: TYPED markers "一、" to "四、" in a hanging column, nested TYPED "（一）" "（二）". The "收货说明" list has decimal markers DRAWN BY CSS, recorded without them. The two signature boxes at the foot (purchaser, supplier) are labels with empty fields, not key sentences. Letterhead lines (Chinese name, English name, address) and the page line "第 1 页 共 1 页" are furniture.
